R-10.title: Council formulation statement
R-10.text: Where settle() cannot fix the formulation and the author documents none, the council states it (3D / plane strain / plane stress / axisymmetric) only with code evidence quoted by file:line: hard-coded 6-component loops or DDSDDE/STRESS indices 4..6 (3D only), NTENS/NDI/NSHR/nsigma branches (the branch chosen is named; other branches are not exercised), or author comments. Rule of choice: if the code is 3D-only, 3D; if it branches, the general 3D branch (NTENS=6) is chosen, because it exercises every component and needs no plane-stress condensation. Recorded per row as formulation {statement, element, evidence, origin=council_choice, ref}. Kinematics (NLGEOM) stays as already recorded (registry/harvest).
R-10.no_silent_default: No row receives 3D without a quote; rows not listed here are unaffected.
